row: Buffalo Rehab Group, the leading provider of Physical and Occupational Therapy in Western New York, is here to help you get your life back after injury or surgery. With 13 convenient locations and the option for virtual care, we provide easy access to our services. Our expanded hours and commitment to prompt care mean you'll get the treatment you need when you need it -- with an average wait time of fewer than seven days to get started.
